name: ESMA MiCA register — CASP / EMT / ART lists
description: Harvest target. ESMA's register of crypto-asset service providers and related lists, published under MiCA Articles 109-110.

dated_observations.note: Quoted with its date and NOT restated as current. A register count moves weekly; an undated count is a claim with a decaying truth value.

existing_normalisers.name: CASP-Tracker
existing_normalisers.note: normalises to JSON with SHA-256 verification

niche_occupancy.consequence: A census here would be a third copy of an existing artefact. Recorded so the build decision is made with the competitor in view, not after.

handling_of_non_compliant_lists.rule: ESMA's NCASP determinations are ESMA's. They are quoted verbatim with attribution and are NEVER re-graded, re-scored, or restated as a Council of AI finding.
handling_of_non_compliant_lists.why: Republishing an enforcement listing as our own finding would convert someone else's regulatory action into our accusation.

checks: entry_retrievable — present in the published CSV at retrieved_at
status_quoted — ESMA's own status field, verbatim

what_this_does_not_establish: No CASP named in the ESMA register is a client of the Council of AI.
Authorisation is ESMA's determination, not ours, and appearing on a non-compliant list is ESMA's finding, not ours.
No count on this door is asserted as current; each carries its own as_of.
doctrine: We measure; we do not certify. Someone else's enforcement action is never restated as our finding.
